EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.mobileProductionMeaning: STORE_MVP=ON — advanced surfaces (buyPrice, priceSpread, trendPrediction, newsSentiment, ytStats, watchlist, pushAlerts, premium) are HIDDEN on the mobile production (AAB/APK) build. Already explicit in eas.json build.production.env (and inherited by production-apk) — no change needed.
EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.webProductionMeaning: STORE_MVP=ON on Web Production. This branch's committed vercel.json buildCommand explicitly runs `EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP=1 expo export` behind the `EXPECTED_VERCEL_BRANCH=main` branch guard, so the Web production bundle bakes the same define value as mobile production. Recorded at this PR's head (ci/dic-1401-web-production-store-mvp-define); once merged into `origin/main` this describes the live Web Production build. A missing/blank/invalid define is impossible here by construction: the define is injected on the `expo export` command itself and `test:store-mvp-define-guard` fails CI otherwise.
EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.reason: Deploy-profile release flag parity: mobile production (eas.json build.production / production-apk) and Web production (this PR's committed vercel.json; the canonical file on main once merged) both explicitly inject EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP=1, so the built native and web bundles gate the same unreleased surfaces. `test:store-mvp-define-guard` and `test:release-flags-parity` cross-validate both sides against the committed config.
EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.followUp: Runtime fallback still to fix (separate from deploy-profile parity, DEV-gate scope, assigned to Mac-Claude): src/config/releaseFlags.ts resolveStoreMvp() currently falls back to `Platform.OS !== 'web'` when the define is unset — fail-open on web. After that code fix lands, remove that fallback so a missing/blank/invalid define fails closed on every Production surface. This ledger stays 'synced' only for the deploy-profile contract these files enforce; it is not a substitute for the runtime fix.
